Container.Name: cfb-tracker
Container.Overview: Stat Scraps with Scrappy: a self-hosted college football hub (plus other sports): live scores, schedules, stats, rankings, news, recruiting, accounts with followed teams, game alerts and a Home Assistant integration. Set ADMIN_PASSWORD and SESSION_SECRET before starting.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the site is served on.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database (accounts, follows, notable games) and push keys. Keep this on appdata so updates don't wipe it.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the /admin notable-games editor. The admin login stays off while this is blank or 'changeme'.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Long random string that signs login cookies (at least 16 characters). Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Favorite team id
Config.Description: ESPN team id pinned at the top (259 = Virginia Tech).

Config.Name: Favorite team name
Config.Description: Display name for the pinned team.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The site's public address, e.g. https://sports.example.com. Needed for single sign-on and calendar links.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 when behind a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik, Cloudflare tunnel) so login rate limits see real visitor IPs.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for logs.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: Allow sign-up
Config.Description: Set to false to stop new email/password sign-ups.

Config.Name: SSO issuer
Config.Description: OpenID Connect issuer URL (Tinyauth, Authentik, Authelia...). Register PUBLIC_URL/auth/sso/callback as a redirect URI there.

Config.Name: SSO client id
Config.Description: OIDC client id.

Config.Name: SSO client secret
Config.Description: OIDC client secret.

Config.Name: SSO button label
Config.Description: Text on the single sign-on button.

Config.Name: SSO scopes
Config.Description: OIDC scopes to request.

Config.Name: Game alerts
Config.Description: Set to false to stop push alerts when followed teams' games start and end.

Config.Name: VAPID subject
Config.Description: Contact for push alerts, e.g. mailto:you@example.com.

Config.Name: VAPID public key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to generate keys once into the app data folder.

Config.Name: VAPID private key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to generate keys once into the app data folder.

Config.Name: CFBD API key
Config.Description: Free key from collegefootballdata.com/key. Turns on Transfer Portal, Top Recruits and Class Rankings.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key (Scrappy chat)
Config.Description: Turns on Scrappy, the AI sports chat bubble. Get a key at console.anthropic.com. Leave blank to hide the bubble.

Config.Name: Scrappy model
Config.Description: Claude model Scrappy uses.

Config.Name: Ollama URL (Scrappy chat)
Config.Description: Run Scrappy on an Ollama server instead of Claude, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434, or https://ollama.com with an API key.

Config.Name: Ollama model
Config.Description: Ollama model Scrappy uses. It must support tool calling.

Config.Name: Ollama API key
Config.Description: Key from ollama.com/settings/keys. Needed for ollama.com cloud models, and turns on Scrappy's web search.

Config.Name: SearXNG URL (Scrappy web search)
Config.Description: Your SearXNG instance, for Scrappy's web search without an Ollama key. Enable the json format in its settings.

Config.Name: Scrappy provider
Config.Description: anthropic or ollama, if both are configured. Blank picks Claude when its key is set.

Config.Name: Scrappy messages per minute
Config.Description: Chat messages each visitor IP may send per minute.

Config.Name: Scrappy messages per day
Config.Description: Chat messages each visitor IP may send per day.

Config.Name: Cache seconds
Config.Description: How long ESPN responses are cached before refetching.

Config.Name: NCAA API base
Config.Description: Optional self-hosted ncaa-api (github.com/henrygd/ncaa-api), used if ESPN is down.

Config.Name: NCAA API division
Config.Description: Division for the ncaa-api fallback: fbs, fcs, ii or iii.

Config.Name: ESPN relay key
Config.Description: Long random string that turns on /espn/... so BingeBandit can share this tracker's ESPN cache.

Config.Name: BingeBandit address
Config.Description: BingeBandit's address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8484. Adds Watch on BingeBandit links to the game page's Where to watch box. Uses the ESPN relay key unless a BingeBandit key is set below.

Config.Name: BingeBandit link address
Config.Description: Optional: the address browsers should open BingeBandit at, if it differs from the one above (e.g. its public URL).

Config.Name: BingeBandit key
Config.Description: Optional: key sent to BingeBandit. Leave blank to use the ESPN relay key; either way it must match BingeBandit's Sports data key.

Config.Name: News feeds
Config.Description: Optional JSON array of {"name","url"} RSS feeds that replaces the News tab defaults.

Config.Name: Recruiting feeds
Config.Description: Optional JSON array of {"name","url"} RSS feeds for the Recruiting page.

Config.Name: YouTube channels
Config.Description: Optional JSON array of {"id","name"} YouTube channels for the videos section.

Config.Name: News article images
Config.Description: Set to 0 to skip looking up each article's preview image (faster, fewer requests).
